criterion: Runtime CHA2 vocabulary is frozen to 8 states
notes: HOME, WORK, BUSINESS, EDUCATION, ESCORT, LEISURE, OTHER, SHOPPING.

criterion: HOME is resolved only through ResidentialAnchor
notes: RETURN_HOME is excluded from generic LocationSupply.

criterion: ESCORT remains relational, not generic OSM supply
notes: A1 generic eligible-purpose wording is narrowed by A5 overlay; A3 already excludes ESCORT.

criterion: WORK and EDUCATION are person-stable primary locations
notes: No multi-workplace/institution extension is silently introduced.

criterion: BUSINESS/SHOPPING/LEISURE/OTHER are occurrence-resolved
notes: Activity-node continuity remains mandatory.

criterion: Authoritative source is raw public Geofabrik Berlin OSM PBF
notes: Provider/source family consistent with A3 raw-tag needs.

criterion: Snapshot is dated/immutable by identity
notes: OSM_GEOFABRIK_BERLIN_2026-10-04_V1; latest alias forbidden.

criterion: Dated provider artifact is currently discoverable
notes: Geofabrik index exposes berlin-261004.osm.pbf and MD5 sidecar; exact bytes/hashes captured only during B acquisition.

criterion: Operational study boundary remains frozen Berlin LOR
notes: Raw extract envelope is evidence only; outside-Berlin generation remains unauthorized.

criterion: Licensing/privacy policy is compatible with public extract
notes: ODbL attribution required; public Geofabrik extract excludes contributor personal metadata fields cited by provider.

criterion: Eligibility registry is closed-world/default-deny
notes: Unmapped tags are excluded and counted; no opportunistic post-acquisition admission.

criterion: Lifecycle/inactive exclusions override include rules
notes: Disused/abandoned/demolished/proposed/construction etc. excluded.

criterion: One physical object may support multiple purposes
notes: Canonical object with union of eligible purposes; no fake per-purpose duplicate.

criterion: Geometry policy is deterministic and auditable
notes: Nodes use coordinates; polygons use point_on_surface; invalid geometry excluded/audited.

criterion: Mode/service infrastructure is not used as generic destination evidence
notes: Protects M3 mode-blind boundary.

criterion: Eligibility, attractiveness and capacity remain distinct
notes: A3 eligibility does not imply A4 weight or capacity.

criterion: Base operational attractiveness/capacity are not fabricated
notes: Canonical fields remain None until an explicit downstream scoring/capacity freeze.

criterion: Residential footprint area is only a sampling-mass proxy
notes: No occupancy/person-capacity claim.

criterion: Generic OSM capacity-like evidence is raw audit evidence only
notes: No automatic promotion to structural capacity.

criterion: Unknown attractiveness/capacity do not mean zero
notes: Missing evidence does not make an A3-eligible location ineligible.

criterion: Exact S_ATTR transformation is intentionally deferred
notes: Raw evidence may be audited in B; scoring must be frozen before any candidate execution.

criterion: Evidence sidecar requires an exact repository schema before C
notes: Blocks C materialization, not raw acquisition/audit.

criterion: ESCORT linked-person mechanism remains unresolved
notes: Must be resolved before F4.2 execution containing ESCORT.

criterion: Residential point-realization rule remains unresolved
notes: Must be frozen before residential-anchor materialization in C.

criterion: Outside-Berlin generation policy remains unresolved
notes: B is Berlin-only. Resolve before F4.2 if candidate semantics require external destinations.

criterion: No destination/home assignment is authorized by A5
notes: Only acquisition + integrity/provenance + audit operations are permitted.

criterion: No S_NEAR/S_DIST/S_ATTR execution is authorized
notes: Candidate implementations remain unopened.

criterion: No G3 CAL/TEST or candidate selection is authorized
notes: A5 does not open evaluation.

criterion: G1/G2 and consumed MiD TEST remain untouched
notes: No upstream gate reopening.

criterion: A3+A4 support/audit requirements are jointly sufficient for first B pass
notes: Counts, unmapped tags, purposes, geometry, fallback, duplicates, areas, capacity-like fields, LOR coverage and outliers are required.
